assessment.report:
# Small-task routing: final scoped readiness

The user-approved bounded correction is implemented in the existing shared role/execution/acceptance contracts and team-dev/team-core entrypoints. Small code-changing team-dev work defaults to a named domain implementer plus Tester; every material implementation retains an independent Reviewer. Risk is evaluated by actual effect, not line/file count or Markdown extension. Ordinary 'fix it' language is not personal Lead-only approval. An explicit approved exception transfers Tester planning/execution to Lead self-check, not independent evidence; a no-delegation/material-review conflict requires user direction. Named-role absence never authorizes silent generic or Lead fallback.

Every applicable engineering obligation remains independent of roster size. Conditional PRD/Blueprint/UI/test-layer requirements remain conditional; start/preflight precedes any child, including Tester packet planning; close reconciles actual calls and checks. Debug retains bounded controlled diagnosis without repair authority. Explicit activation remains unchanged. No runtime spawn API, parser/schema change, global hook/config change, new role/model, refactor or automatic enforcement is introduced. This extends unreleased 0.9.1 without stable promotion.

Lead inspected the initial contracts and final actual diff, current architecture/README/release policy, and complete final stage packet. Named Docs Maintainer implemented the owned instruction edits; named Tester prepared a structurally validated packet before writer release and completed native validation, isolated package/stage/documentation/fake-home installation suites, plus native/package rerun after final source clarifications. All passed and fixtures were removed. Named Reviewer independently reviewed final amended source and six semantic cases, reporting no material findings. Tester test files and runtime code were not changed for this task: wording assertions cannot prove agent decisions. Supplementary Python Skill helper was unavailable on PATH; native package checks passed. Source definitions/tool profiles are separate from unreported resolved runtime identity.

The final packet was structurally validated with manual pending. All real-agent routing E2E scenarios and human acceptance remain pending; source walks and successful package tests do not establish achieved runtime coverage. Previously uncommitted coverage-sync changes remain intact. Other inventoried docs and prior scopes are not re-certified; changes to relevant evidence still require their own freshness checks before future reuse. This record is a scoped semantic readiness assessment, not an authenticated approval or whole-project correctness certificate. No commit, push, actual install or external service was used.
